mapper.select: SELECT 'WALLET' AS recipient_type, w.wallet_id AS recipient_id, u.name AS recipient_name, w.wallet_number AS account_number, u.invite_code AS user_code FROM users u JOIN wallets w ON w.child_id = u.user_id WHERE u.invite_code = #{keyword} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND w.status = 'ACTIVE'
